annotations.title: Pay during maternity, birth and parental leave in the Netherlands

description: Income during leave after a birth in the Netherlands (2026): maternity leave (UWV, 100% up to the daily wage cap), birth leave for the partner (1 week by the employer, up to 5 extra weeks at 70% from UWV) and paid parental leave (9 weeks at 70% from UWV), with what each parent receives and loses compared with normal pay.

birth_parent_gross_monthly.description: Gross monthly salary of the parent giving birth, euros

holiday_pay_on_top.description: Salaries are without the 8% holiday allowance (it comes on top). Default true.

parental_leave_weeks_birth_parent.description: Paid parental leave weeks for the birth parent, 0-9. Default 9.

parental_leave_weeks_partner.description: Paid parental leave weeks for the partner, 0-9. Default 9.

partner_extra_birth_leave_weeks.description: Extra birth leave weeks the partner takes, 0-5. Default 5.

partner_gross_monthly.description: Gross monthly salary of the partner, euros (0 if not working). Default 0.

name: birth_parental_leave_pay
